title: PreMortem Risk Item
description: A single risk item identified by the PreMortem AI system.

id.description: Unique risk identifier, typically a UUID or short token.

title.description: Human-readable descriptive title for the risk.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the risk scenario.

probability.description: Likelihood of risk occurring, between 0 and 1.

impact.description: Impact severity if risk occurs, 1 to 5 scale.

llm_score.description: Raw severity score predicted by the LLM before rule-based adjustments.

human_score.description: Optional human-provided score used in blended severity calculation.

mitigation.description: Optional mitigation strategy or recommended action.
